title: Workflow and renovate.json have no automated validation or dry-run smoke coverage
reasoning: This workflow is the single automation owning all dependency updates, yet nothing validates it before it runs: no actionlint/syntax check on renovate.yml, no schema check that renovate.json still exists and parses (configurationFile is referenced at line 53 with no guard), and no dry-run smoke run in CI. Any expression typo, invalid cron, missing renovate.json, or under-scoped RENOVATE_TOKEN is only discovered at the weekly Monday 5am scheduled run (or a manual dispatch), where a failure blocks all dependency updates for a week. The comment block at lines 47-49 even documents a failure mode (Workflows scope missing causes silent PR failures) that no check enforces.
recommendation: Add a CI job (or extend an existing test workflow) that runs actionlint on .github/workflows/renovate.yml, validates renovate.json against Renovate's config schema, and executes a `RENOVATE_DRY_RUN=full` smoke run with a low log level on pull requests touching the workflow or config.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests list for this feature is empty; the vitest-based test command covers application code, not workflow YAML semantics or Renovate configuration.
suggestedRegressionTest: CI job: `actionlint .github/workflows/renovate.yml` and `renovate --dry-run=full --config=renovate.json` validation that fails on any workflow/config drift.
minimumFixScope: Add a validation job to CI plus a presence/schema check for renovate.json referenced at line 53.
